description:
Order Methylone MDMA Crystals Online

Buy Methylone MDMA Crystals Online. Methylone Crystals is a stimulant drug with a mild hallucinogenic effect. It’s recommended to treat it with caution, because of its short existence, not much research has been conducted.

Methylone Crystal is an empathogen and stimulant psychoactive drug. Methylone is also called bk-MDMA or beta-keto-MDMA. This shows methylone’s similarity to the club drug Ecstasy, which is alternately described as MDMA.

Methylone crystal is a chemical drug which is very similar in structure to MDMA and has comparable effects.

Full Name: 3,4-Methylenedioxy-N-methcathinone

Molecular Formula: C11H13NO3

Average mass: 207.226 Da

Monoisotopic mass: 207.089539 Da

 

What is Methylone?

Methylone Crystals for sale online cheap. Methylone, also known as 3,4-Methylenedioxy-N-methcathinone, M1, MDMC, βk-MDMA, is an entactogenic and stimulant drug of the cathinone chemical class that produces a mixture of entactogenic, stimulating, and euphoric effects when administered.

Usually, methylone is offered as powder, but pills are in circulation as well. As with XTC, these tablets can differ in size, colour, and strength.

Status

In the Netherlands, methylone doesn’t fall under the Opium Act, but under the Medicines Act. At the same time, it’s not officially registered as a medicine. Therefore, a general practitioner cannot prescribe it, and it’s only possible to obtain the substance illegally.

As it is in the Medicines Act, other sanctions apply for trading than for drug trafficking. Illicit trafficking in medicines may lead to a maximum of six years imprisonment, whereas illegal trafficking in substances on the Opium Act – e.g. MDMA, can lead to a maximum of twelve years imprisonment.

The status of it differs per country. In the United States, for example, it is on the Opium List, and in Canada, it isn’t. The Canadian authorities do not even consider it a medicine, which means the substance is still legal over there.
